description: Approve or reject a workflow run's jobs waiting on a protected environment (`environment:` with required reviewers). The caller must be a reviewer of every environment selected (the environment's reviewers, or the repository owner when none are listed). An approval runs the job (after the environment's wait timer, if any); a rejection fails it. Mirrors POST /api/v2/repos/.../actions/runs/:id/pending_deployments. Requires 'repo' scope.

environments.description: Environment names (or ids), as strings, to decide; omitted = every waiting one

run_id.description: The run's id, or a unique leading part of it (8+ hex characters)

name: gluecron_review_deployment
